name: ideal-qr-tool
description: Orchestrator scripts để chạy backend (uvicorn) + frontend (Vite) cùng lúc

scripts.dev:backend:win: cd backend && set IDEAL_QR_TOOL_BIND_HOST=127.0.0.1&& .venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8989 --reload --reload-dir app
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend test && cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q
